root_cause: Daily personal sources were new event ids of the same event types (loop_assurance_refresh, source_health_evaluated) with the same underlying figures. Rotation after a STORY_FAMILY_DUPLICATE denial moved to alternatives of the same kind and produced the same story again; 2026-10-16/17/18/21/26 were blocked or failed.

observed_evidence.varied_days: 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-25 used an external business problem or public theme and were published

fix: Treat event types used by a published personal post in the last 7 days as stale: the orchestrator prefers a fresh source, the founder reserve drops stale event types and lists the external business problem first. Fallback keeps the previous choice.
prevention_rule: Story uniqueness is judged by story family. Rotation must change the story family, never loosen the duplicate guard or the identity gate.
terminal_rule: Merged main, deployed powerhouse-content-orchestrator, then the next personal run shows a source whose event types are not in the previous 7 days' published posts, or an external business problem.
